messages:
Linea: quick sync - prototype for deferred-repair queue + eviction coordination. tl;dr: enqueue repairs, bump eviction score while repair in-flight, cooldown to avoid loops.
Diego: sounds promising. core question: how do we cap global rehydrates?
Linea: global token-bucket + per-tenant soft cap. default global_qps=200, per_tenant_qps=3.
Suresh: what about hot prefixes that keep getting demoted and rehydrated? we need a backoff on rehydrate attempts per-prefix.
Linea: per-prefix cooldown 60s + exponential backoff on repeated failures. also set repair-in-flight pin that increments residency score to prevent eviction.
Maya: for correctness, can readers prefer authoritative path if they carry recent-write token? avoids repair for RW flows.
Linea: yes — we prototyped a short-lived write-token (ttl 5s) emitted on write path. readers with token route to owner.
Diego: metrics to add: repair_queue_depth, repair_latency_p95, repair_retries, eviction-score-bump-rate.
Suresh: runbook? ops-bot should be able to pause repair queue and drain in case of storms.
Linea: ops-bot: actionable toggle added: /ops toggle repair-queue -> paused/resume. logs a trace.
ops-bot: repair-queue pause toggled by Linea at 2025-04-05T11:42Z.
Maya: rollout: staging smoke -> 1% tenants -> 10% -> opt-in. gating: repair_qps < 0.25% read_qps, repair_failure_rate < 1%, sustained queued repairs < 500.
Linea: ok I'll draft RFC addendum with config knobs and telemetry. will post later today.
